subject: P3: Remove state.workspace / state.overlay / WS_FILE / boot pin
description: Phase 3, final (see system note "SPEC: deprecate daemon global workspace pointer"). Depends on P2a+P2b. Delete the global pointer entirely: remove state.workspace and state.overlay from the state object (daemon.js ~220), the WS_FILE read at loadState (~336-348), the WS_FILE write in setWorkspace (~2057), and the boot `POST /workspace` self-pin at mcp-graph.js:81 (keep workspace REGISTRATION into workspaces.json — just stop treating any one as the global default). After removal, any graph op (read or write) that arrives without a resolvable workspace returns HTTP 400 with a clear message instead of silently using a default. setWorkspace becomes "register + select for THIS session/SSE client" not "set the daemon global". Update all remaining state.workspace/state.overlay references (51 in daemon.js + routes). Update/extend tests: test/workspace-read-target, workspace-write-target, workspaces-daemon must assert 400-on-missing-workspace and multi-workspace isolation. Full suite green. Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: Fixed all 7 P3 regressions on orch/attempt/d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b-4 (7 commits atop 88af373, one per regression for resilience). Full suite now 157/167; the 10 remaining failures are exactly the pre-existing environmental baseline (orch-gate, orch-gate-bash, cursor-*, codex-hooks, classify-hook-*, dispatcher-model, judge-hook-nudge) — proven pre-existing by running them on base d95f1d8 (orch-gate 8/12 fail and orch-gate-bash 20/25 fail identically on base). grep-zero on state.workspace/overlay/graphStore reconfirmed. Per-regression: (1) workspace-fallback-warn CLASS A — rewrote the obsolete P1 warn-scaffold test to assert the P3 no-global invariant (targetOverlay ws=null without explicit ws; resolves explicit ws; __resetWorkspaceFallbackSeamsForTest absence). (2) apply-patch-confinement MIXED — Class A (test passed workspace to /mark-root + /git/worktree) PLUS Class B: /active-claim and /task/detail resolved to null ws so the gate (which queries by session/key with no workspace) couldn't see claims/worktrees; both now scan registeredWorkspaces(); added registeredWorkspaces to route ctx in daemon.js. (3) filedrop-daemon CLASS B — snapshotNative(ov,key,ns,ws) ws param dropped by 3 callers in routes/overlay.js, so readNativeTask(undefined) skipped the terminal-status snapshot fold; pass T.ws at all 3. (4) note-edge-structboost CLASS A — Layer-B HTTP helpers default workspace into bodies/queries. (5) per-repo-workspace-scoping CLASS A — rewrote no-param 'global=B' assertions to P3 (/state,/ready,/judge/pressure 400; /should-stop stop:false), preserving per-repo scoping intent. (6) phase2-integration CLASS A — mark-root passes workspace so unwired flag clears on the right overlay. (7) should-stop-advisory CLASS A — mcpTool stamps x-orch-workspace so /mcp resolves the target ws. NOT merged — judge + dispatcher handle integration.
